method.commit_match: blob: the target's git blob is in an indexed repository and the chosen commit holds the most of the set's files; closest: the target is in no repository and the commit holding the most set files is recorded. Among equivalent commits a branch or tag reaches (all when none does), the chosen one is the earliest carrying a tag, else the latest
method.creation_blocks: eth_getCode is empty at block b-1 and non-empty at block b; the transaction is Blockscout's creation transaction, which the node returns
method.epochs: an optimizer, supply vault, rewards manager or lens proxy follows its EIP-1967 Upgraded logs from its creation block, and its slot at the pinned block equals the last; every other subject holds one code from its creation block to the pinned block
method.solc_reproduction: the verified input with outputSelection narrowed to the target, compiled by the solc linux-amd64 build of its version; immutable ranges zeroed on both sides. exact: equal; sans-cbor: equal once the trailing CBOR metadata is removed from both
method.source_sets: one compilation from Blockscout's verified record, else Sourcify's; a subject without its own record joins the set whose compiled runtime best equals its code, else its creator's set compiled with every contract selected
method.subject_set: the seed Morpho publishes (its SDK address book and the optimizers' README deployment lists) closed over Morpho's own wiring and creation events, Blue's market creations and each subject's EIP-1967 slot; a named contract is a subject when Morpho wrote it and it falls in an approved group, and is excluded with its class otherwise; see c_registry.py
